entities.summary: Markus Villig is an Estonian billionaire entrepreneur and founder and CEO of global shared mobility company Bolt Technology OÜ. As of 2019, he is Europe's youngest founder of a billion dollar company (unicorn). Following Bolt's fundraise in late 2021 which saw the company reach an $8.4 billion valuation, Markus became Europe's youngest self-made billionaire aged 27.
